ab.h1: Stillness of the heart is not a feature — it's a ritual.
ab.lede: Sakina is the tranquillity Allah sends down upon the hearts of the believers. Modern apps are often the opposite of that. We're building the inverse: a product that leaves the heart lighter after using it.

p1.d: No ad networks. No affiliate links inside answers. No pop-ups.

p2.d: No Google Analytics. No Meta Pixel. No AppsFlyer. Only the product itself, server logs, and anonymous performance metrics.

p3.d: Our AI answers only from authenticated sources and never issues fatwa. Personal legal questions are routed to qualified scholars.

p4.d: Illustrations are pure geometry. Prophet stories ﷺ ship as text and audio — never as depicted faces.
p4.t: No images of people or the Ka'ba.

p5.d: Encryption at rest. Full export on request. Deleting your account cascades through everything.

p6.d: Premium and Family exist for one reason — so we never have to sell you to advertisers.

ask.a1_html: The Quran places sabr among the believer's defining qualities and promises the patient a reward without measure Quran 39:10. When the heart contracts, He reminds us that He is with the patient Quran 2:153, and that ease follows every hardship Quran 94:5. The Prophet ﷺ was commanded to bear "a beautiful patience" Quran 70:5 — without complaint to creation.

priv.lede: We treat your data as an amanah — something entrusted to us for safekeeping. No ads, no trackers, no partners.
priv.ch3_h: How a note ends up in the database.
priv.ch3_p: A four-step chain — at every step the data is unreadable to any outside service.
priv.ch3_s1_m: The text exists only in your browser. Nothing is sent yet.
priv.ch3_s2_m: TLS 1.3 (Vercel Edge). Between you and the server — no one reads.
priv.ch3_s3_m: The note text is encrypted with a key from envelope encryption. The key lives in Vercel KV, not in Supabase.
priv.ch3_stat2_s: Every 90 days the primary key is re-issued. Old keys are retained to decrypt.
priv.ch3_stat3_s: Data in Supabase. Keys in Vercel KV. One service can't see the other.
priv.ch3_stat4_s: When you delete your account, the data is wiped within 30 days. Backups within 90.
priv.ch4_h: How many times we've been asked to hand over data.
priv.ch4_p: This log is updated every quarter. We publish every single request, within what the law allows.
priv.ch4_footer: Sakeenly is registered in the EU. The Russian 152-FZ law does not directly apply, but we comply with GDPR. See the full policy for details.
priv.ch5_h: What you can do with your data.
priv.ch5_export_p: A JSON file with all your bookmarks, notes, streak, and question history. One click in your profile.
priv.ch5_delete_p: Full data wipe within 30 days. No questions, no retention, no win-back emails.
priv.ch5_request_p: Want to know everything we hold about a specific email? Write to
priv.quote_eyebrow: The principle Sakeenly is built on

aem.body_intro: This collection draws on the ayat that scholars, imams, and ordinary people have leaned on for centuries in moments of fear, anxiety, panic, sleeplessness, and despair. They do not treat anxiety the way medicine does — but they give you the anchor without which treatment cannot hold.
aem.scholar_quote: "Anxiety is not proof that your iman is weak. The Prophet ﷺ himself asked Allah for protection from anxiety and grief every day: Allahumma inni a'udhu bika min al-hammi wa-l-hazan. This collection is not a substitute for du'a, and it is not a substitute for a doctor."
aem.disclaimer_body: If you are experiencing prolonged anxiety or thoughts of self-harm — please see a doctor. Sakeenly is not a substitute for medical care.
aem.cta_h: Save these ayat to your library.
aem.cta_body: One tap — and your bookmarks sync across every device.
